python -c "
import collections,csv
c=collections.Counter()
raw=open('bench/data/sales.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig').read().splitlines()
for ln in raw[1:]:
    ln=ln.strip()
    if not ln: continue
    c[ln.split(',')[0].strip()]+=1
print('sum',sum(c.values()))
for k,v in c.most_common(): print(k,v)
"
